headline: Heavy rain in the South 8–13 Nov, Krabi included today; boats may be delayed in storms.

warnings.title: Flood watch, 16 provinces incl. Krabi, 9–13 Nov
warnings.detail: DDPM: heavy rain in the South; beware flash floods near hills and low-lying areas.

warnings.title: Flood watch, southern provinces incl. Krabi
warnings.detail: DDPM, 5–9 Nov: risk of flash floods and run-off; heaviest rain 7–9 Nov.

ferries.detail: No current suspension found; boats can stop in high waves, so confirm with the operator or hotel the day before.

news.title: Heavy rain in 14 provinces today, Krabi included
news.detail: Rain most of the day around Krabi and Phi Phi; skip boat trips today.

news.title: TMD: heavy rain back in Krabi tomorrow, 12 Nov
news.detail: Avoid boat trips on the 12th; waves above 2 m in storms. Easing expected from 14 Nov.

news.title: TMD: rain easing in the South from 14–15 Nov
news.detail: Wet and stormy until 13 Nov; plan boat trips and snorkelling for after the 14th.

news.title: Heaviest rain today on the Gulf side, not Krabi
news.detail: Andaman coast gets scattered storms; Krabi not on today's heavy-rain list.

news.title: DDPM: 16 provinces on flood alert 9–13 Nov
news.detail: Krabi included; heavy rain tomorrow, avoid low-lying streets in downpours.

sourceTitle: Nation Thailand: heavy rain in the South 7–9 Nov
